indicator_name: Finished Goods Price Expectations Diffusion Index (NBK Enterprise Survey)
description: Индекс диффузии ожиданий цен на готовую продукцию (опрос предприятий НБ РК)
methodology: Diffusion index (0-100, 50=neutral). NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors') aggregate of enterprises' EXPECTED change in their own FINISHED GOODS prices next quarter -- a firm-side inflation-expectations gauge, complementing the household-side INFLATION_EXPECTATIONS. History back to 2005-Q2.
